thread:
lexi_cs: Morning team, kicking off Nectar onboarding. Quick goals for sprint-0 (10 days): integrate Redwood Hosted into their ticket pipeline, validate staging latencies, and run a Console training with their CSMs. Who owns each lane?

maria_pm: I'll be their PM contact. Weekly sync Wed 9am PT works. I'll loop in Derek (infra) and their SRE in an intro email today.

derek_it: Noted. Their infra requires IP allowlist + webhook delivery over TLS. Derek (Nectar) will share CIDR ranges. We might need VPC peering if they want direct connection.

toby_success: I'll draft success criteria: 1) 95th percentile inference latency <500ms on staging for 75% of sample prompts, 2) Console runbook walkthrough completed by Nectar CSMs, 3) End-to-end ticket flow validated in staging.

sam_eng: I'll handle integration support and model choice. Need their sample payloads and staging API key. Also, share a short smoke test they can run: curl example.

onboard-bot: Checklist link: /docs/onboarding/nectar-template. Reminder: Complete "security questionnaire" step for EU data residency.

lexi_cs: Action list: maria to intro Derek and SRE by EOD; Nectar to provide sample payloads + staging keys by Day 2; sam to provide smoke test + initial model recs Day 1-3; toby to draft acceptance tests Day 2. Note: flag renewal risk if go-live slips past Day 28.

maria_pm: ACK, sending intros and will request anonymized tickets (10 examples) for benchmarking.

derek_it: I'll open an infra ticket for allowlist/peering. ETA 48h. If peering delayed, we'll use secure proxy tunneling.

lexi_cs: Also capture any legal/compliance gating now (especially for EU). If Dedicated is required for data residency, we'll show cost/ops delta in the follow-up.

toby_success: I'll validate routing options and fallback policy for EU by tomorrow and post notes in the board.

sam_eng: Sharing quick curl snippet for their engs (sanity check): curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"Summarize ticket body"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

lexi_cs: I'll set up the sprint board and invite owners. First sync Wed 9am PT. Please drop blockers in the board before then. Feedback ask after first 48h: what was unclear in the runbook?

maria_pm: Thanks, team. Excited to start.

(onboarding thread ended)
